description.value: Kingswood Liquor Store is a community-serving independent liquor retailer on No 5 Road in Richmond, stocking spirits, wines, coolers, beer, snacks, and tobacco with a large cold single-beer and cooler section. The store advertises competitive pricing below government rates and offers delivery through SkipTheDishes and Fantuan. Free on-site parking makes it an easy stop for cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms this is a real, operating liquor store at 9371 No 5 Rd, Richmond, BC. No bike-specific amenities (rack, washroom, water) are mentioned anywhere on the site. Two different phone numbers appear on the site: 778-297-4344 in the page header and 604-434-8327 on the dedicated contact page — this discrepancy is flagged in concerns.
concerns: Two different phone numbers appear on the website: 778-297-4344 in the site header and 604-434-8327 on the dedicated contact page. The contact-page number (604-434-8327) has been used as the primary value, but this should be verified.
OSM record has no address or phone tags — address and phone were sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible retail liquor store confirmed via website. A convenient stop for touring cyclists needing supplies.
